text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Casablanca hosts seminar organised by the World weather forecasts on development of services in Africa.
- Moroccan NGOs vow to combat corruption and propose Jan 6 as national day.
- Collision between Spanish trawler and Moroccan ferry causes no damage.
- Staff at state-owned railway Office National des Chemins de Fer worried ahead of privatisation.
- Head of General Confederation of Moroccan Enterprises says Association accord with the European Union not enough to back Morocco's economy.
